name: Jarvis
postCreateCommand: python -m pip install --upgrade pip && python -m pip install -e './jarvis[mcp]'

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Your Anthropic API key, from platform.claude.com > API keys. Stored by GitHub, never in this repository.

JARVIS_GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Optional: a GitHub fine-grained token so Jarvis can work on all your repositories (Contents and Pull requests: read and write). Without it, Jarvis only reaches this repository.
